subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — NovaRetail inference proof-of-concept
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.inference>
To: Evan Turner <evan.turner@novaretail.com>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novaretail.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 15:10:00 -0800
Subject: Demo: Redwood Inference — NovaRetail inference proof-of-concept

Hi Evan / Sarah,

Thanks for the chat earlier — excited by the idea of helping NovaRetail speed up how you serve ranking and personalization models in production. I put together a short 30-minute demo to show:
- Our hosted inference paths and Dedicated options
- Typical latency / cost tradeoffs and a few batching/caching levers
- A quick run through of model variant routing for graceful fallback

Would 30 minutes next week work? I proposed:
- Tue, Mar 2 @ 10:00am PT
- Wed, Mar 3 @ 1:30pm PT

I've attached the demo slides and included a calendar invite for the first slot (if that helps). If you prefer, here's a Calendly link to pick a time: https://calendly.com/redwood/demo-30m

Open to adjust — let me know which time works and I’ll send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Aisha Rahman
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference
<aisha@redwood.inference>
Redwood Inference
Attachments: Redwood_Demo_Slides.pdf, calendar-invite.ics

From: Evan Turner <evan.turner@novaretail.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha@redwood.inference>
Cc: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@novaretail.com>
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Demo: Redwood Inference — NovaRetail inference proof-of-concept

Hi Aisha — thanks for the proposal and the slides. Appreciate the clear agenda.

Quick update from our side: we're in the middle of finalizing Q2 priorities and leadership has asked us to deprioritize new infra/LLM projects for the next 60–90 days while we lock down headcount and budget. Also, a couple of folks on my team will be traveling the first week of March which makes scheduling harder.

Can we pause for now? If anything changes I’ll ping you, otherwise I expect we can revisit in mid- to late-May. Please keep us on file and feel free to send any short-read materials I can share internally.

Sorry to disappoint — I know the timing is off on our end rather than the fit.

Best,
Evan
Head of ML Platforms | NovaRetail
Evan.Turner@novaretail.com

Thanks for the quick note, Evan — understood and totally reasonable.

Quick follow ups so we can keep things tidy on our side:
1) Would you like me to mark the HubSpot deal as "paused / deprioritized" with a follow-up reminder in ~90 days?
2) I’ll drop a 1-pager and the slide deck (attached) that you can circulate with leadership so they have the overview if priorities shift.
3) If it helps, we can also do a 15-minute async walk-through (recording + timestamped notes) that you could share internally.

CC’ing Priyom from CSM — if/when you want to reconnect we can scope a short POC plan that minimizes engineering lift.

I’ll hold off on sending any calendar invites for now. Let me know what you prefer for follow-up timing and I’ll set the next touch.

Thanks again,
Aisha
